summary: BEFORE fixed cap-64 backpressure: peak 64, drain 0.75ms; AFTER AIMD adaptive cap (16-256): peak 16, drain 1.27ms (slower beyond noise 9.3%). Adaptive cap buys lower peak memory at control-loop cost. Adopt only where memory headroom is the constraint.
